title: World editor button freezes on tap and never opens on iPhone
reproduction: Confirm Kelo Studio appears and is interactive.
Close/remove the Studio shell or reproduce the stale-session condition.
Open Create -> World again and confirm Studio remounts instead of black-screening.
expected: World opens, remains interactive, and can be reopened even after a stale Studio shell/session condition.
actual: Player report 2026-09-14: tapping World froze the card and Kelo Studio never appeared. Hub z-index 2147482100 covered Studio z-index 320, Hub backdrop-filter sat on the live canvas, and a hung Studio import left opening[] stuck so retries were swallowed.
evidence: Commit 829ac7fbd5fc629b05ecf92489bab16b0292bce9: fix(studio): keep World editor responsive when IndexedDB hangs (#222)
REPORT-000001: player, iPhone 393x852, World card stays frozen after tap
Local Chromium: openKeloStudioLive mounts in ~240ms; Creator Hub click path opened Studio then hid it under the Hub
owner_hint: Kelo Creators / World workspace + Kelo Studio live shell stacking

fix.summary: World launch paints a curtain, yields with timers not rAF, times out the Studio import at 12s, parks/hides the Hub so Studio is not covered, raises #kelo-studio-live above the Hub, and removes Hub backdrop-filter over the live canvas.

verification.method: Real iPhone Safari E2E: enter game -> Create -> World -> Studio chrome visible and tappable. Do not mark PASS from headless_shell alone.

notes: Visibility of #kelo-studio-live alone is not sufficient acceptance; the editor must respond to touch/placement and reopen successfully.
Do not mark VERIFIED until the deployed flow passes on the target device class.
Studio graph must stay lazy until World is tapped (live-studio-click-audit).
headless_shell can freeze after Studio mounts because of the overlay canvas loop; that is not the player-facing Hub-cover bug.
